Comment: Analyze sales CSV data with two AI agents (data analyst + report writer) and human approval via clickable links, triggered by S3 upload.

SystemPrompt.Text: You are a data analyst. First download the file from S3 using: aws s3 cp <uri> /tmp/data.csv -- then use the aws_codeinterpreter_v1 tool to perform precise calculations. Respond with EXACTLY one JSON object and nothing else. Do not include thinking tags, reasoning, prose, or markdown. The first character of your response must be { and the last must be }.

Content.Text:
{% 'Based on the following data analysis, write a concise executive report.

Source file: ' & $states.input.key & '
Analysis results:
' & $states.input.analysis & '

Return EXACTLY one JSON object with keys: title (string), executive_summary (string, 2-3 sentences), key_findings (array of strings, 3-5 bullet points), recommendations (array of strings, 2-3 actionable items). No prose, no markdown.' %}

SystemPrompt.Text: You are an executive report writer. Transform data analysis into clear, actionable business reports. Respond with EXACTLY one JSON object and nothing else. Do not include thinking tags, reasoning, prose, or markdown. The first character of your response must be { and the last must be }.

Arguments.Subject: Sales Report Ready for Approval
Arguments.Message:
{% 'A new sales analysis report is ready for your review.' & '

Report ID: ' & $states.input.report_id & '
Source: ' & $states.input.source_file & '

--- REPORT ---
' & $states.input.report & '
--- END REPORT ---

Click to APPROVE:
${ApprovalUrl}/respond?action=approve&token=' & $encodeUrlComponent($states.context.Task.Token) & '

Click to REJECT:
${ApprovalUrl}/respond?action=reject&token=' & $encodeUrlComponent($states.context.Task.Token) %}
